children: Get back to doing what you love
Orthopedic & sports physical therapy for injury recovery, post-op rehab and getting back to full strength. We find the cause, treat it hands-on, and rebuild you to do more than before.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every therapist here is a licensed DPT with orthopedic and sports training. You get expert care from someone who understands the demand you’re getting back to.
A full session with your therapist — not passed off to an aide or a machine. Real hands-on treatment and coaching, every visit.
We work with most major plans and make the benefits side simple, so you can focus on getting better instead of paperwork.
A clear diagnosis, a real plan, and a target to be back to your sport, your job or your routine — not an open-ended schedule of visits.

children: Evaluate, treat, rebuild — the Momentum method
Most rehab chases the pain. We chase the cause. Every patient starts with a full evaluation, so we treat the reason the tissue failed — not just the spot that hurts.

From there it’s hands-on treatment to settle things down, then loaded, progressive rehab to build real capacity back. That last step is what keeps the injury from coming back — and gets you doing more than you did before.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Momentum Physical Therapy is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: An open rehab gym with treatment tables and training equipment

children: We built Momentum for the people other clinics send home with a sheet of exercises and a shrug. Athletes, weekend warriors, post-op patients, anyone whose life doesn’t stop when something gives out.

It’s part treatment room, part training floor. We diagnose hard, treat hands-on, and load you back to full capacity — because getting out of pain and getting back to what you love are two different jobs, and we do both.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every plan starts with how you move. We find the weak link before we treat the pain, so we fix the cause, not just the symptom.
Manual therapy and dry needling to settle things down, then progressive, loaded rehab to build real strength back.
We work to a target — a return-to-sport date, a lift, a job task — not an open-ended schedule of maintenance visits.
